articles.title: Perplexity Co-Founder: AI Safety Is an Excuse to Lock Down Frontier

articles.title: AI Researchers Got Chatbots to Share Cocaine Recipes Using This One Wild Trick
articles.snippet: Researchers say a new jailbreak technique tricked AI models into treating attacker-written text as their own reasoning, bypassing safety guardrails and exposing a deeper security flaw.

articles.title: UN's First AI Safety Panel Says Scientists Can't Rule Out 'Catastrophic Harm'
